basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a college student from the Midwest with a growing passion for building custom PCs. I recently discovered the intricate world of PC components and am excited to learn more. My interests also include sketching anime characters and participating in online scavenger hunts. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after classes and work part-time as a barista. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends catching up on anime and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm a self-taught PC enthusiast. I started by watching YouTube tutorials and joining forums to gather information about building PCs. My interest intensified as I began to participate in discussions on subreddits like buildapc, and I am slowly building my knowledge base through trial and error.
